Name: Yurumanguí
Remark: Vocabulary recorded by Fr. Christoval Romero, 1768, accompanying the expedition diary of Capt. Sebastián Lanchas de Estrada; heading names the Indians of the rivers Yurumanguí, Cajambre, Naya, San Vicente, San Nicolás, el Palmar and San Carlos (Pacific lowlands, Valle del Cauca, Colombia), so a single variety is not guaranteed. Manuscript: Archivo Nacional, Bogotá, Curas y Obispos t. 44, fol. 218v-221r (second copy in the same volume), as collated by Rivet 1942.
